name: field-mesh-save-candy
command: env RF_MESH_TIMEOUT_S=900 npm run mesh:save -- --world candy

name: field-mesh-save-common
command: env RF_MESH_TIMEOUT_S=900 npm run mesh:save -- --world common

name: field-mesh-save-other
command: env RF_MESH_TIMEOUT_S=900 npm run mesh:save -- --world ice --world jungle --world neon

name: field-render
command: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { copyFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; const pre = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', 'tools/fieldPreflight.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (pre.status !== 0) process.exit(pre.status ?? 1); const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', 'tools/chromeCheck.ts', 'fieldShading', '--out', 'out/field-shading'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (run.status !== 0) process.exit(run.status ?? 1); mkdirSync('proofs/field-shading', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('out/field-shading/report.json', 'proofs/field-shading/field-shading.json');"

name: field-judge-world
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/candy-world.png --description "a complete candy world of Royal Fiesta with smooth shaded surfaces: every candy building, platform and decoration is present with complete geometry, curved candy shapes have continuous smooth lighting with no faceting, colour boundaries between candy materials are clean, and there are no black, inverted or dark-streaked surfaces" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-scenery
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/rounded-scenery.png --description "a close view of rounded candy scenery in Royal Fiesta: complete rounded shapes with continuous smooth lighting across their curves, clean soft boundaries between candy colours, no faceted colour patches and no dark streaks" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-penguin
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/penguin.png --description "a close view of a cartoon penguin in a walking or emoting pose wearing cosmetics: its rounded body and the cosmetics are complete and smoothly lit, the boundaries between black, white and orange and the cosmetic colours are clean, with no dark streaks, faceted patches or inverted lighting" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-mechanisms-a
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/mechanisms-a.png --description "a close view of moving candy mechanisms (a swinging hammer and mechanical parts) in Royal Fiesta: complete geometry with smooth continuous lighting on their rounded surfaces, clean colour boundaries, no dark streaks or faceted colour patches" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-mechanisms-b
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/mechanisms-b.png --description "a close view of moving candy mechanisms (a swinging hammer and mechanical parts) in Royal Fiesta: complete geometry with smooth continuous lighting on their rounded surfaces, clean colour boundaries, no dark streaks or faceted colour patches" --min-score 6
